subject: DI04005011

body.en:
Definition

In industrial biotechnology,fermentation is controlled microbial cultivation/bioconversion to produce useful biomass,metabolites or enzymes.The industrial term includes aerobic processes;it does not mean every fermentation excludes oxygen.

Classification first

By oxygen need:anaerobic/oxygen-limited ethanol versus aerobic citric-acid or vinegar production.By operation:batch,fed-batch and continuous.By medium:submerged/liquid,solid-state and surface processes.By product:biomass,primary metabolites,secondary metabolites and enzymes.Penicillin is a representative secondary metabolite;ethanol/lactic acid are common primary-metabolite examples,but timing depends on the organism/process.

Common fermenter construction and control

A qualified fermenter includes cleanable vessel,agitation/aeration where needed,heat-transfer surfaces,sterile feed/air interfaces,instrumentation and contained sampling/venting.Inoculum development and contamination prevention precede production.Recovery is product-specific:ethanol distillation,organic-acid salt recovery or antibiotic extraction are not interchangeable.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Industrial biotechnologyમાં useful biomass,metabolites/enzymes બનાવવા controlled microbial cultivation/bioconversion એટલે fermentation. Industrial શબ્દમાં aerobic processes પણ આવે છે;દરેક fermentation oxygen વગર થાય એવો અર્થ નથી.

વર્ગીકરણ

Oxygen મુજબ anaerobic/oxygen-limited ethanol તથા aerobic citric-acid/vinegar. Operation મુજબ batch,fed-batch,continuous. Medium મુજબ submerged/liquid,solid-state તથા surface processes. Product મુજબ biomass,primary metabolites,secondary metabolites તથા enzymes. Penicillin representative secondary metabolite છે;ethanol/lactic acid common primary-metabolite examples છે,પણ timing organism/process મુજબ હોય છે.

સામાન્ય Fermenter Construction તથા Control

Qualified fermenterમાં cleanable vessel,જરૂરી agitation/aeration,heat-transfer surfaces,sterile feed/air interfaces,instrumentation તથા contained sampling/venting હોય છે. Production પહેલાં inoculum development/contamination prevention જરૂરી. Ethanol distillation,organic-acid salt recovery તથા antibiotic extraction product-specific છે,એકબીજાના બદલે નહીં.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Fermentative ethyl alcohol is ethanol produced by yeast conversion of fermentable sugar,followed by recovery and grade-specific purification.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Molasses/sugar solution,water,nutrients and an approved production yeast,commonly Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

C6H12O6 → 2C2H5OH + 2CO2;342g sucrose +18g water can theoretically give184g ethanol after hydrolysis.

Your supplied drawing—page 10

Reference historical benzene-assisted anhydrous branch is not a recommendation;new optional dehydration can use an appropriate modern process.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Medium and seed preparation

Molasses is diluted/conditioned and heat-treated as required,then cooled to protect the culture.The separate seed train develops active yeast and transfers it through hygienic lines.The fermenter provides cooling because sugar conversion releases heat;oxygen management differs between seed growth and the production phase.

2. Fermentation and CO2wash

Yeast converts fermentable sugars to ethanol with CO2evolution.The reference off-gas washer recovers entrained/alcohol vapour into water and sends gas to approved recovery or vent treatment.Residual broth,called beer here,is a dilute ethanol-containing liquid,not a finished beverage specification.

3. Distillation,rectification and dehydration

The beer still strips ethanol from broth,leaving stillage;aldehyde removal and rectification separate volatile heads/fusel-oil cuts and concentrate alcohol.Simple ordinary rectification cannot pass the ethanol–water azeotropic limitation to arbitrarily dry ethanol.Optional dehydration requires a suitable separate technology.The historical PDF benzene-assisted branch is identified only as historical;the new study route does not recommend benzene contact with a modern product.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control contamination,fermentation heat,CO2asphyxiation,flammable alcohol,vapour losses and stillage treatment.No beverage/home-distillation procedure is supplied.

Properties / applications

Chemical solvent,fuel blend and approved industrial feed;pharmaceutical/food uses require their own licensed grade and testing.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Yeastથી fermentable sugar convert કરીને તથા recovery/grade-specific purificationથી મળતું ethanol fermentative ethyl alcohol છે.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Molasses/sugar solution,water,nutrients તથા approved production yeast,સામાન્ય રીતે Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

C6H12O6 → 2C2H5OH + 2CO2;342g sucrose +18g water can theoretically give184g ethanol after hydrolysis.

તમે મોકલેલું Drawing—પાનું 10

મૂળ drawingના equipment names અને દેખાતા connections પ્રમાણે નીચે working સમજાવ્યું છે. Faint/clipped ભાગ માટે complete study redraw પણ આપ્યો છે;અસ્પષ્ટ labelsને અંદાજથી exact design માન્યાં નથી.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Medium તથા Seed Preparation

Molasses dilute/condition તથા જરૂરી heat-treat થઈ cultureને બચાવવા cool થાય છે. Separate seed train active yeast વિકસાવી hygienic linesથી transfer કરે છે. Sugar conversionમાં heat નીકળતી હોવાથી fermenter cooling આપે છે;seed growth તથા productionનું oxygen management જુદું હોય છે.

2. Fermentation તથા CO2Wash

Yeast sugarsને ethanolમાં ફેરવે છે અને CO2નીકળે છે. Reference off-gas washer entrained/alcohol vapourને waterમાં recover કરીને gas approved recovery/vent treatmentમાં મોકલે છે. અહીં beer એટલે dilute ethanol-containing broth;finished beverage specification નહીં.

3. Distillation,Rectification તથા Dehydration

Beer still brothમાંથી ethanol strip કરે છે અને stillage બચે છે;aldehyde removal/rectification heads,fusel-oil cuts જુદાં કરીને alcohol concentrate કરે છે. Ordinary rectification ethanol–water azeotropic limit પાર કરીને મનસ્વી dry ethanol આપતું નથી. Optional dehydration માટે separate suitable technology જોઈએ. PDFની benzene-assisted branch historical તરીકે ઓળખાવી છે;new route modern productમાં benzeneની ભલામણ કરતું નથી.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Contamination,fermentation heat,CO2asphyxiation,flammable alcohol,vapour loss/stillage treatment નિયંત્રિત કરવા;beverage/home-distillation procedure નથી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Chemical solvent,fuel blend તથા approved industrial feed;pharmaceutical/food uses માટે licensed grade/testing જરૂરી.

notes.reaction: C6H12O6 → 2C2H5OH + 2CO2;342g sucrose +18g water can theoretically give184g ethanol after hydrolysis.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Lactic acid is a hydroxycarboxylic acid produced here by selected microbial conversion of corn-derived sugar,followed by salt recovery and acid regeneration.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Corn sugar,water,nutrients,approved lactic-acid production culture and a controlled calcium neutralising system.

C6H12O6 → 2CH3CH(OH)COOH(ideal homolactic balance);Ca(C3H5O3)2 + H2SO4 → 2C3H6O3 + CaSO4.

Your supplied drawing—page 11

Original includes technical/food polishing and optional methyl-lactate esterification/hydrolysis branch;grade requires testing,not a label alone.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Fermentation and neutralisation

Conditioned/treated corn-sugar medium receives approved seed culture.The organism converts sugar to lactate;neutralisation limits acid inhibition and forms calcium lactate in the representative route.The selected culture determines stereochemical product distribution;one must not assume every fermentation gives the same L/D ratio.

2. Broth clarification and lactate concentration

Separation removes cells/solids;carbon treatment and filtration reduce colour/organic impurities.The reference shows calcium-lactate processing and liquor concentration before acid release.Mother liquor and solids carry losses,so recovery and washing matter as well as fermentation conversion.

3. Acid release and grade-specific polishing

Controlled acidification converts calcium lactate to free lactic acid and precipitated calcium sulfate.Gypsum filtration prevents solid contamination before concentration.The source also shows an optional methyl-lactate esterification/distillation/hydrolysis purification route;it is an alternative polishing branch,not a compulsory ingredient of food lactic acid.Labelled technical/food grades still require analytical release.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control contamination,pH,stereochemistry,residual sugars,colour,gypsum and recovery yield;acid-resistant materials and waste treatment are required.

Properties / applications

Grade-specific acidulant,chemical intermediate and lactide/PLA feed after required purity/stereochemistry control.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Corn-derived sugarના selected microbial conversion તથા salt recovery/acid regenerationથી અહીં hydroxycarboxylic lactic acid બને છે.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Corn sugar,water,nutrients,approved lactic-acid culture તથા controlled calcium-neutralising system.

C6H12O6 → 2CH3CH(OH)COOH(ideal homolactic balance);Ca(C3H5O3)2 + H2SO4 → 2C3H6O3 + CaSO4.

તમે મોકલેલું Drawing—પાનું 11

મૂળ drawingના equipment names અને દેખાતા connections પ્રમાણે નીચે working સમજાવ્યું છે. Faint/clipped ભાગ માટે complete study redraw પણ આપ્યો છે;અસ્પષ્ટ labelsને અંદાજથી exact design માન્યાં નથી.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Fermentation તથા Neutralisation

Conditioned/treated corn-sugar mediumમાં approved seed culture આવે છે. Organism sugarને lactateમાં ફેરવે છે;neutralisation acid inhibition ઘટાડે છે તથા selected routeમાં calcium lactate બને છે. Cultureથી stereochemical distribution નક્કી થાય છે;બધી fermentationમાં L/D ratio સમાન માનવો નહીં.

2. Broth Clarification તથા Lactate Concentration

Separation cells/solids દૂર કરે છે;carbon treatment/filtration colour/organic impurities ઘટાડે છે. Referenceમાં acid release પહેલાં calcium-lactate processing/concentration છે. Mother liquor તથા solidsમાં losses જાય છે,એટલે recovery/washing પણ conversion જેટલાં મહત્વનાં છે.

3. Acid Release તથા Grade-specific Polishing

Controlled acidificationથી calcium lactate free lactic acid તથા precipitated calcium sulfate આપે છે. Gypsum filtration પછી concentration થાય છે. Sourceમાં optional methyl-lactate esterification/distillation/hydrolysis polishing છે;તે alternative branch છે,food lactic acidનું ફરજિયાત ingredient નહીં. Technical/food labels છતાં analytical release જરૂરી છે.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Contamination,pH,stereochemistry,residual sugar,colour,gypsum તથા recovery yield નિયંત્રિત કરવા;acid-resistant materials/waste treatment જોઈએ.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

જરૂરી purity/stereochemistry control પછી grade-specific acidulant,chemical intermediate તથા lactide/PLA feedમાં ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Citric acid is a tricarboxylic organic acid obtained industrially by controlled aerobic fungal fermentation of sugar feed such as molasses.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Conditioned molasses,water,carefully managed nutrients/trace metals and approved Aspergillus niger production culture with sterile air.

C6H12O6 + 3/2O2 → C6H8O7 + 2H2O(idealised net product balance;actual broth also forms biomass/by-products). Calcium-citrate recovery:Ca3(C6H5O7)2 + 3H2SO4 → 2C6H8O7 + 3CaSO4.

Your supplied drawing—page 9

Original shows additional calcium-oxalate/impurity handling before citrate recovery;wash filtrates are pooled where appropriate.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Medium conditioning and aerobic culture

Molasses treatment removes suspended matter and adjusts inhibitors/trace-metal levels.The reference preconditioning,including calcium-oxalate/impurity removal where shown,precedes inoculation and the aerobic culture stage.Agitation/air contact and cooling provide oxygen and heat removal.Microbial citric-acid accumulation requires the appropriate nutrient balance;high sugar alone does not guarantee good yield.

2. Mycelium removal and citrate recovery

Filtration separates fungal mycelium and washings recover product-bearing liquor.Controlled lime treatment precipitates calcium citrate,which is separated and washed.This intermediate concentrates product and removes some soluble impurities;it is not the final free acid.

3. Acidification,polishing and crystals

Controlled sulfuric-acid decomposition releases citric acid and forms gypsum.After gypsum separation,carbon/ion-exchange polishing reduces impurities;evaporation and crystallisation form the specified crystals.Centrifuging and drying finish the product,with mother liquor managed for recovery/purge.Crystal hydration state and purity depend on controlled finishing/testing.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control oxygen transfer,culture morphology,trace metals,foam,contamination and gypsum/effluent disposal;unapproved mould is not safe food culture.

Properties / applications

Approved food acidulant,sequestering/cleaning agent and chemical/pharmaceutical formulation feed by grade.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Molasses જેવા sugar feedની controlled aerobic fungal fermentationથી મળતો tricarboxylic organic acid citric acid છે.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Conditioned molasses,water,managed nutrients/trace metals,approved Aspergillus niger production culture તથા sterile air.

C6H12O6 + 3/2O2 → C6H8O7 + 2H2O(idealised net product balance;actual broth also forms biomass/by-products). Calcium-citrate recovery:Ca3(C6H5O7)2 + 3H2SO4 → 2C6H8O7 + 3CaSO4.

તમે મોકલેલું Drawing—પાનું 9

મૂળ drawingના equipment names અને દેખાતા connections પ્રમાણે નીચે working સમજાવ્યું છે. Faint/clipped ભાગ માટે complete study redraw પણ આપ્યો છે;અસ્પષ્ટ labelsને અંદાજથી exact design માન્યાં નથી.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Medium Conditioning તથા Aerobic Culture

Molasses treatment suspended matter દૂર કરીને inhibitors/trace metals adjust કરે છે. Referenceમાં calcium-oxalate/impurity removal સહિતનું preconditioning inoculation/aerobic culture પહેલાં છે. Agitation/air contact/cooling oxygen તથા heat removal આપે છે. Citric-acid accumulation માટે nutrient balance જોઈએ;ફક્ત high sugarથી good yield નિશ્ચિત નથી.

2. Mycelium Removal તથા Citrate Recovery

Filtration fungal mycelium દૂર કરે છે અને washings product-bearing liquor recover કરે છે. Controlled lime treatment calcium citrate precipitate કરે છે,જે separate/wash થાય છે. Intermediate product concentrate કરે છે તથા કેટલીક soluble impurities દૂર કરે છે;તે final free acid નથી.

3. Acidification,Polishing તથા Crystals

Controlled sulfuric-acid decompositionથી citric acid છૂટે છે અને gypsum બને છે. Gypsum separation પછી carbon/ion-exchange polishing impurities ઘટાડે છે;evaporation/crystallisationથી specified crystals બને છે. Centrifuge/dryingથી finish થાય છે અને mother liquor recovery/purgeમાં જાય છે. Hydration state/purity finishing/testing પર આધારિત છે.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Oxygen transfer,culture morphology,trace metals,foam,contamination તથા gypsum/effluent disposal નિયંત્રિત કરવા;unknown mould safe food culture નથી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Grade મુજબ approved food acidulant,sequestering/cleaning agent તથા chemical/pharmaceutical formulation feed.

notes.reaction: C6H12O6 + 3/2O2 → C6H8O7 + 2H2O(idealised net product balance;actual broth also forms biomass/by-products). Calcium-citrate recovery:Ca3(C6H5O7)2 + 3H2SO4 → 2C6H8O7 + 3CaSO4.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Vinegar is a dilute acetic-acid food product obtained here by aerobic microbial oxidation of an ethanol-containing feed.The supplied Frings arrangement is a recirculating packed wood-shaving generator.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Qualified dilute alcoholic feed,approved acetic-acid bacteria,nutrients as specified and filtered oxidation air.

C2H5OH + O2 → CH3COOH + H2O(exothermic);overoxidation can reduce acid yield.

Your supplied drawing—page 8

Source page8explicitly labels shavings,wood grating,cooling coils,vinegar filter and centrifugal pump.The new drawing preserves the packed-generator recycle loop.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Packed-generator construction

The source drawing shows top rubber/feed lines and spray jets,a bed of wood shavings on a wood grating,filtered oxidation-air entry,an exhaust,and a lower collection chamber with cooling coils.An external vinegar filter,centrifugal pump and flow-meter/feed line return cooled liquor to the top.This is not the submerged acetator drawing,and its packing/supports must not disappear from the explanation.

2. Trickling contact and biological oxidation

Alcohol-containing liquor is distributed over the colonised shavings and trickles through the packed bed.Filtered air supplies oxygen to the wetted microbial film.Acetic-acid bacteria oxidise ethanol to acetic acid while releasing heat.Airflow and wetting must be distributed evenly;dry channels or oxygen starvation lower productivity and can harm the culture.

3. Collection,cooling and recirculation

Liquid collects below the wood grating and cooling coils remove fermentation heat.The external filter removes suspended material;the centrifugal pump sends cooled filtered liquor back to the spray distributor.A controlled product draw leaves only when quality requirements are met.Recirculation permits repeated contact;it is not a separate chemical reaction or proof of complete conversion on one pass.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control temperature,oxygen,wetting,packing hygiene,acid strength and residual alcohol;unknown contaminated cultures must not be tasted.

Properties / applications

Approved vinegar for food/processing uses only after acidity,microbial and grade checks;industrial acetic acid is not automatically food vinegar.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Ethanol-containing feedના aerobic microbial oxidationથી મળતું dilute acetic-acid food product vinegar છે. અહીં supplied Frings arrangement recirculating packed wood-shaving generator છે.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Qualified dilute alcoholic feed,approved acetic-acid bacteria,જરૂરી nutrients તથા filtered oxidation air.

C2H5OH + O2 → CH3COOH + H2O(exothermic);overoxidation can reduce acid yield.

તમે મોકલેલું Drawing—પાનું 8

Source પાનું8માં shavings,wood grating,cooling coils,vinegar filter તથા centrifugal pump સ્પષ્ટ છે. New drawing packed-generator recycle loop જાળવે છે.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Packed-generator Construction

Source drawingમાં top rubber/feed lines તથા spray jets,wood grating પર wood-shavings bed,filtered oxidation-air entry,exhaust તથા cooling coilsવાળું lower collection chamber છે. External vinegar filter,centrifugal pump તથા flow-meter/feed line cooled liquorને top પર પાછું મોકલે છે. આ submerged acetatorનું drawing નથી;packing/supports explanationમાંથી કાઢવા નહીં.

2. Trickling Contact તથા Biological Oxidation

Alcohol-containing liquor colonised shavings પર વહેંચાઈ packed bedમાંથી trickle થાય છે. Filtered air wetted microbial filmને oxygen આપે છે. Bacteria ethanolને acetic acidમાં oxidise કરે છે અને heat છોડે છે. Airflow/wetting uniform હોવાં જોઈએ;dry channels/oxygen starvationથી productivity/cultureને નુકસાન થાય છે.

3. Collection,Cooling તથા Recirculation

Wood grating નીચે liquor collect થાય છે અને cooling coils heat દૂર કરે છે. External filter suspended material કાઢે છે;centrifugal pump cooled filtered liquorને spray distributorમાં પાછું આપે છે. Quality requirements પછી controlled product draw થાય છે. Recirculation repeated contact આપે છે;તે અલગ reaction કે one-pass complete conversion નથી.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Temperature,oxygen,wetting,packing hygiene,acid strength/residual alcohol નિયંત્રિત કરવા;unknown contaminated cultures ચાખવા નહીં.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Acidity,microbial તથા grade checks પછી approved food/processing vinegar;industrial acetic acid આપમેળે food vinegar નથી.

notes.reaction: C2H5OH + O2 → CH3COOH + H2O(exothermic);overoxidation can reduce acid yield.

body.en:
Given → Find → Formula → Substitution → Answer

1.Given:1000kg solution with20%fermentable glucose;actual ethanol=80kg.

2.Find:theoretical ethanol and %of theoretical.

3.Glucose=1000×0.20=200kg.C6H12O6→2C2H5OH+2CO2.

4.Theoretical ethanol=200×92/180=102.22kg(using rounded molecular masses).

5.Actual/theoretical=80/102.22×100=78.26%.Recovered mass and assay basis must be stated.

body.en:
Aim

Study alcohol production by fermentation

Principle

Approved yeast converts sugar into ethanol and CO2;recovery is a separate operation.

Apparatus/materials

Approved teaching culture/medium,supervised small fermenter,temperature record and approved assay or simulation.

Supervised procedure / record

Follow the institution culture SOP and record feed,approved inoculum identity,conditions and observations.An approved assay establishes ethanol,while bubbles alone do not.If recovery is only demonstrated,record its apparatus and boundaries without attempting personal distillation.

Blank observations—actual experiment required

Sugar basis(g):____;culture:____;time/temperature log:____;assay method/result:____

Calculations and result

Ideal glucose ethanol mass=0.511×glucose mass;actual recovery requires measured ethanol mass and stated assay basis.

Result:____;units:____;SOP/reference:____.No experiment/readings/results have been fabricated.

Precautions and waste

No tasting,home beverage making or uncontrolled sealed fermentation;vent CO2safely and decontaminate cultures.
body.gu:
હેતુ

Fermentationથી Alcohol Productionનો અભ્યાસ

સિદ્ધાંત

Approved yeast sugarને ethanol/CO2માં ફેરવે છે;recovery અલગ operation છે.

Apparatus/Materials

q.en: Explain the principle of Fermentation—definition and classification.

a.en: In industrial biotechnology,fermentation is controlled microbial cultivation/bioconversion to produce useful biomass,metabolites or enzymes.The industrial term includes aerobic processes;it does not mean every fermentation excludes oxygen. By oxygen need:anaerobic/oxygen-limited ethanol versus aerobic citric-acid or vinegar production.By operation:batch,fed-batch and continuous.By medium:submerged/liquid,solid-state and surface processes.By product:biomass,primary metabolites,secondary metabolites and enzymes.Penicillin is a representative secondary metabolite;ethanol/lactic acid are common primary-metabolite examples,but timing depends on the organism/process.
a.gu: Industrial biotechnologyમાં useful biomass,metabolites/enzymes બનાવવા controlled microbial cultivation/bioconversion એટલે fermentation. Industrial શબ્દમાં aerobic processes પણ આવે છે;દરેક fermentation oxygen વગર થાય એવો અર્થ નથી. Oxygen મુજબ anaerobic/oxygen-limited ethanol તથા aerobic citric-acid/vinegar. Operation મુજબ batch,fed-batch,continuous. Medium મુજબ submerged/liquid,solid-state તથા surface processes. Product મુજબ biomass,primary metabolites,secondary metabolites તથા enzymes. Penicillin representative secondary metabolite છે;ethanol/lactic acid common primary-metabolite examples છે,પણ timing organism/process મુજબ હોય છે.

q.en: Explain the principle of Ethyl alcohol by fermentation.

a.en: Fermentative ethyl alcohol is ethanol produced by yeast conversion of fermentable sugar,followed by recovery and grade-specific purification. Molasses/sugar solution,water,nutrients and an approved production yeast,commonly Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
a.gu: Yeastથી fermentable sugar convert કરીને તથા recovery/grade-specific purificationથી મળતું ethanol fermentative ethyl alcohol છે. Molasses/sugar solution,water,nutrients તથા approved production yeast,સામાન્ય રીતે Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

q.en: Explain the principle of Lactic acid from corn sugar.
q.gu: Corn Sugarમાંથી Lactic Acidનો સિદ્ધાંત સમજાવો.

a.en: Lactic acid is a hydroxycarboxylic acid produced here by selected microbial conversion of corn-derived sugar,followed by salt recovery and acid regeneration. Corn sugar,water,nutrients,approved lactic-acid production culture and a controlled calcium neutralising system.
a.gu: Corn-derived sugarના selected microbial conversion તથા salt recovery/acid regenerationથી અહીં hydroxycarboxylic lactic acid બને છે. Corn sugar,water,nutrients,approved lactic-acid culture તથા controlled calcium-neutralising system.

q.en: Explain the principle of Citric acid from molasses.

a.en: Citric acid is a tricarboxylic organic acid obtained industrially by controlled aerobic fungal fermentation of sugar feed such as molasses. Conditioned molasses,water,carefully managed nutrients/trace metals and approved Aspergillus niger production culture with sterile air.
a.gu: Molasses જેવા sugar feedની controlled aerobic fungal fermentationથી મળતો tricarboxylic organic acid citric acid છે. Conditioned molasses,water,managed nutrients/trace metals,approved Aspergillus niger production culture તથા sterile air.

q.en: Explain the principle of Vinegar by Frings packed-generator method.
q.gu: Frings Packed-generator Methodથી Vinegarનો સિદ્ધાંત સમજાવો.

a.en: Vinegar is a dilute acetic-acid food product obtained here by aerobic microbial oxidation of an ethanol-containing feed.The supplied Frings arrangement is a recirculating packed wood-shaving generator. Qualified dilute alcoholic feed,approved acetic-acid bacteria,nutrients as specified and filtered oxidation air.
a.gu: Ethanol-containing feedના aerobic microbial oxidationથી મળતું dilute acetic-acid food product vinegar છે. અહીં supplied Frings arrangement recirculating packed wood-shaving generator છે. Qualified dilute alcoholic feed,approved acetic-acid bacteria,જરૂરી nutrients તથા filtered oxidation air.
